encoder: legalese-sonnet-5.5: a single Sonnet 5.5 agent working alone from the brief in BRIEF.md
display_name: ePrivacy Directive (Directive 2002/58/EC), consolidated version of 19.12.2009: whole encoding, layer 1 and three seats
seat: the individual who is a user, subscriber or recipient (required, first); further seats: the provider of a publicly available electronic communications service, and the sender of direct marketing
mirror_cases: epd-cases-seat-mirror.l4 (Article 13: the same message put to the recipient's seat and the sender's seat, with agreeing answers)

scope.encoded: Articles 1 to 21 of the consolidated text, including Articles 14a and 15a: every paragraph, subparagraph, sentence and list limb, every defined term of Article 2, with a coverage row for every non-blank line of the file (183 rows: encoded 64, fork 62, inert 56, repealed or blank in this text 1).
scope.not_encoded: the recitals (not in the file); Regulation (EU) 2016/679; Directive 95/46/EC, Directive 2002/21/EC and Directive 2000/31/EC (borrowed terms are inputs); Directive (EU) 2018/1972 (a fork answered NOTHING; the repeal of Directive 2002/21/EC checked against the Publications Office data on 2026-11-17); any Member State's transposing law.
scope.inert_rows: headings, banner, footnotes and machinery (committee procedure, the Commission's implementing measures and procedures, transposition, review, repeal of Directive 97/66/EC, entry into force); see the coverage table in NOTES.md.

edition.text: Directive 2002/58/EC as amended by Directive 2006/24/EC and Directive 2009/136/EC: the Publications Office consolidated version of 19.12.2009 (CELEX 02002L0058-20091219), a plain-text rendering made by a converter script; a documentation tool with no legal effect, not the authentic text
edition.article_15_1a: encoded as printed; the reference to Directive 2006/24/EC may no longer have effect: the Court of Justice's judgment of 8 April 2014 (CELEX 62012CJ0293) is recorded in the Publications Office data as declaring the Directive void, checked 2026-11-17 (fork F4)

not_reviewed: No lawyer or domain expert has read this encoding against the text. The two readings the brief marks "for a lawyer" are applied throughout and listed in NOTES.md under "Marginal readings for a lawyer"; the fork register lists every other reading taken.
